raw.question: Resolve every scoped operator read from the persisted mount identity
raw.chosen: Resolve every scoped operator read from the persisted mount identity
raw.reasoning: Normal mounts store private state under hashed MountStateDir paths. Operator commands must derive the same workspace, remote root, local root, state-file/state-dir, and mount-kind identity instead of assuming legacy files under each child.

retrospective.summary: Resolved scoped status, health, dead-letter, skip-stuck, and writeback reads through each persisted private mount-state identity; regression fixtures now use production hashed paths; full vet and Go suite pass.
